purpose: Separate observation-space projection and scoring from an immutable completed 2D/3D field solve, so changed observational data or nuisance declarations do not trigger or alter the gravity solve.

fieldRequirements: completed field job state is succeeded
model, field job, scientific result, observable archive, and artifact hashes validate
every requested observation target names an observable present in the immutable archive
observationRequirements: observation bundle and archive hashes validate
target array keys, shapes, ranks, and units pass the existing public observation-target contract
target provenance and license remain explicit

claimBoundary: An observation-evaluation job tests only the declared mapping from an already solved field into an observation; it cannot validate the field equation by itself.
Changing a mask, beam, uncertainty, or target creates a new evaluation identity but leaves the source field identity unchanged.
Massive-tracer and photon mappings remain separately typed; P0732 does not add photon lensing.
The local reference queue is not the public durable worker infrastructure.
